why: The YPT format is a domain-specific instance of team-based inquiry, combining collaborative investigation of open-ended problems with differentiated roles, shared solution development, and reflection through debate.

rejected.verifier: The claim concerns YPT overall and does not directly attribute the reported skill development to the structured team-based inquiry practice.
The claim concerns YPT versus regular classes and does not directly assess structured team-based inquiry, assigned roles, interdependent tasks, or group-process reflection.

why: YPT/IYPT is a named international physics competition and educational programme whose inquiry format is being characterized, not a general learning theory.
name: International Young Physicists' Tournament (IYPT)
product_description: An international high-school physics competition run by the IYPT community in which teams investigate open-ended problems, develop and test explanations, and defend their results in discussion.
